thread:
jin: heads-up — planning a short smoke/triage for the fused-kernel + paged-attn changes. branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/compare/fused-paged-optim. objective: confirm no regressions for long sequences (2k and 8k), verify KV-cache integrity, and validate fused-op correctness. targeting A100 (eu-west1) and H100 (us-west1) pools.

alex: ok i can run on h100 tonight. what configs do you want?

jin: thanks. can you run these two quick cases: seq=2048 batch=2 and seq=8192 batch=1. use both kernel sets: baseline (no fusion) and fused+paged. 200 iters each. capture stdout + perf. command below.

maria: FYI i noticed a tiny throughput dip on very long context when testing a local patch earlier — likely memcpy overhead around kv saving. leaving details in the PR comments.

sam: pinging @jin — did the microkernel change touch the attention roll/shift? i saw an off-by-one in one of the tests but couldn't repro.

jin: it shouldn't touch logical shifts. PR modifies matmul tiling + fused softmax path. but possible interaction with paged-kv eviction. i'll add a regression test.

alex: running now. command i use:
```bash
./bench/run.sh --model=llama-13b --device=h100-1 --kernels=baseline
./bench/run.sh --model=llama-13b --device=h100-1 --kernels=fused,paged --seq=8192 --batch=1 --iters=200 --out=run_h100_8192_fused.log
```

leah: i'll take eu-west1/a100 runs tomorrow morning. let me know if you want me to include smaller batches (bs=4 for 2k).

ops-bot: scheduled: bench-h100-1 at 1768543300, bench-a100-eu-1 at 1768580000. logs will be uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/bench/1768543210/

alex: quick raw excerpt from fused run (h100):
```
[RUN] seq=8192 bs=1 kernels=fused,paged iters=200
tokens/sec: 82.3k ±2.1% (expected baseline ~90.5k)
p50 latency: 180ms p95: 420ms
KV-save memcpy spikes at iteration ~53 (peak 12ms)
```

maria: that tokens/sec drop matches what i saw earlier. can you capture a flamegraph around the memcpy spike? `perf record -g` + `perf script | flamegraph.pl` should do it.

alex: ok recording flamegraph now. also rerunning with `-DVERBOSE_KV=1` to log eviction events.

sam: i skimmed the PR — small change in kernel wrapper forgot to zero a temporary buffer on H100 path. could explain intermittent memcpy. i'll push a patch shortly.

jin: nice catch. patch when ready and let's rerun the two failing configs. if the patch fixes the spike we can merge and open a follow-up for additional stress coverage (seq 16k smoke).

leah: added bs=4/seq=2048 runs to the queue.

ops-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-ci/bench/1768543210/run_h100_8192_fused.log (14.2MB), flamegraph: s3://redwood-ci/bench/1768543210/flame_h100_8192.svg

alex: flamegraph shows heavy memcpy from kv_store::persist at ~50-60% stack. filing an issue with stack trace in the PR.

jin: thanks everyone — once sam's patch lands, can we re-run only the fused+paged 8k case on H100 and the 2k bs=4 on A100, and then reconvene async here? no need for a meeting unless failures persist. :thumbsup:

maria: will do. i'll add the new regression test to the CI matrix to catch this earlier.

sam: patch pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5823 — fixes temp buffer zeroing and adds an assert for kv offset. please re-run.

alex: kicked off rerun at 1768543400.

ops-bot: bench-h100-1 rerun scheduled at 1768543400.

alex: rerun snapshot (partial):
```
[RUN] seq=8192 bs=1 kernels=fused,paged iters=200
tokens/sec: 89.7k ±1.3%
p50 latency: 165ms p95: 390ms
no memcpy spikes observed
```

jin: great — looks like the patch fixed the regression. i'm going to merge after CI green and update the rollout policy to canary 5% for next 24h. thanks all.
